fields.subject: Mapping Expression Builders
fields.condition: a property's declared type, after unwrapping Nullable<>, is one of the four generic ShardKey<...> arities and the property carries a MapShardKeyAttribute
fields.trigger: ExpressionHelpers determines the property's shard-key role via GetMapShardKeyAttribute
fields.response: report the property's arity as shard key, child, grandchild or great-grandchild according to the ShardKey<> generic-argument count, and report the property as nullable when its declared type was Nullable<>
fields.postcondition: a property whose declared type is not generic, or that is a ShardKey<...> type without a MapShardKeyAttribute, is reported as none of the four arities and yields a null attribute
